provenance: Historical batch source and binary hashes are preserved. final_source_sha256 describes the delivered files, not earlier prototypes.
limitations: No closed induction proof was found.
Closure-probe rejections are relative to the fixed discovered dictionary and search heuristics; they do not prove a geometric impossibility.
Only the saved local samples, not the complete large graphs, have been audited exactly.
represented_atoms_with_multiplicity counts overlaps; represented_distinct_atoms removes overlap separately for each parameter box.
Different schedulers and stages can choose different roots and rules; unfinished node counts do not measure distance to a proof.
Large original graphs are in temporary directories; compact samples and source hashes are preserved in the repository.
